paper.title: Plug in the Safety Chip: Enforcing Constraints for LLM-driven Robot Agents
paper.central_claim: An expert-verified NL-to-LTL safety chip monitors and prunes proposed actions, explains violations for replanning, and enforces customizable safety constraints while retaining task completion in VirtualHome and on a Spot robot.
